raw_segments.text: Well, if you like, I have the same philosophy as you, that would be true.
Gee, Pence, donk, gee, Swayze, I know that for a fact.
All the rest, all these worlds, God, and even Satan, all that is not proved to my mind.
Does all that exist of itself, or is it only an emanation of myself, a logical development
of my ego which alone has existed forever?
But I make haste to stop, for I believe you will be jumping up to beat me directly."
